map.备案前自查：把第三方检验报告里的铅、砷、汞、甲醇与菌落总数录进来，先判断这批配方: Pre-filing self-check: enter the lead, arsenic, mercury, methanol and total colony count from the third-party test report to judge first whether this formulation can pass filing.
map.按《化妆品安全技术规范》《化妆品监督管理条例》及 GB 7918、GB 7917: The page has the published limits from the Cosmetic Safety Technical Standard, the Cosmetics Supervision and Administration Regulation and GB 7918 / GB 7917 built in (lead <=10, arsenic <=4, mercury <=1, methanol <=0.2, total colony count ordinary <=1000 / special <=500, in mg/kg, colony count in CFU/g). The tool runs entirely in the front end, does not use the network and uploads nothing, so the limits are a fixed set; when regulations change, the latest official text governs.
map.本工具里主要体现在两点：一是菌落总数限值（特殊 ≤500，普通 ≤1000）；二: This tool mainly covers two things: first, the total colony count limits (special <=500, ordinary <=1000); second, the route to market - special cosmetics (hair colouring, perming, spot and whitening, sunscreen, anti-hair-loss, and any claimed new efficacy) must apply to the NMPA for registration, taking about 6-12 months to approve, while ordinary cosmetics only need to be filed on the NMPA platform and can be sold once filed.

map.：输入：汞 1.5（限值 ≤1）→ 该项判定 ✗，整体结论「不符合要求」，页面提: Input: mercury 1.5 against a limit of 1 or less -> that item is judged as failing and the overall conclusion is "does not meet the requirements". The page flags an over-limit item, notes it must not be placed on the market, and requires the formula or process to be adjusted and retested to a pass before filing or registration.
map.：输入：类别=普通化妆品，铅 5、砷 2、汞 0.5、甲醇 0.1、菌落总数 1:
Input: category = ordinary cosmetics, lead 5, arsenic 2, mercury 0.5, methanol 0.1, total colony count 100.
Built-in limits: lead <=10, arsenic <=4, mercury <=1, methanol <=0.2, total colony count (ordinary) <=1000.
Item by item, all 5 of 5 pass -> the conclusion is "meets the filing/registration requirements", and ordinary cosmetics can be sold once filed on the NMPA platform.
If the category is switched to special cosmetics, the total colony count limit tightens to <=500 while the other four limits stay the same.
